name: Peacock Throne
scope: Yes if it is an act of a Delhi sultan or Mughal emperor
boundary: Peacock Throne: Muslim rulers of Delhi and the Mughal court, the Taj Mahal and Timur's sack of Delhi included; the Company's rise goes to The Raj, Persian shahs to Kings of Kings, Ottoman sultans to Sublime Porte, Razia Sultana to Crowned Queens.
example_beats: Qutb ud-Din Aibak founds the Delhi Sultanate (1206)
Tughluq moves the capital to Daulatabad (1327)
Shah Jahan begins the Taj Mahal (1632)
